text:
Kelsey Moore: Quick idea: run a 4-week 'remediation rhythm' pilot focused on closing postmortem actions faster. low ceremony.
Diego Alvarez: what's low ceremony look like?
Kelsey Moore: owners get a 48h ack DM, a 7d unblock check, and a 14d close-or-escalate. plus a single weekly 30m triage for owners.
Rina Sethi: love. can we add an automated 'repeat-hit' marker if a service appears in 3 incidents in 90d? bump to follow-up tier.
Tom Becker: +1 on repeat detection. also we should keep IC rotation separate from remediation leads. avoid overloading ICs after war room.
Diego Alvarez: ok. who runs the weekly triage? rotating 'remediation lead' for that week?
Kelsey Moore: yes—rotation by volunteers, fallback to oncall lead. rotation length: 1 week.
Rina Sethi: proposal: keep an ownership scoreboard (sheet) with columns: owner | action | due | status | repeat-count | notes. steward updates it.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: "remediation-rhythm-pilot" -> DM owners at 48h, 7d, 14d
Tom Becker: can we track metrics from day 1: median time-to-close, % closed by 14d, # repeat-hit flags/week. put graphs in the ops dashboard.
Diego Alvarez: I'll prototype the repeat detector: simple tag aggregation by service over rolling 90d window. output = count + last-incident-ts.
Kelsey Moore: communications: short templated nudges only. example DM: "hi <owner>, quick check on PM action <id> — status? blockers? ETA?" keep it one line.
Rina Sethi: suggest an optional "cleanup sprint" slot on Thursdays for owners to pair on cross-team actions. 30m max.
Tom Becker: pilot boundary: infra + infra-adjacent teams only for 4 weeks. then measure and decide.
Diego Alvarez: question: escalation path? owner -> remediation lead -> oncall lead -> eng manager?
Kelsey Moore: yes, exactly. and remediation lead should only escalate after 72h blocked.
ops-bot: runbook uploaded: /docs/incidents/remediation-rhythm-runbook.md
Rina Sethi: action items: Kelsey: pilot plan + rota; Diego: repeat detector proto; Tom: dashboard sheet; I'll write nudges and short owner playbook.
Kelsey Moore: aiming to start next Monday. anyone opposed?
Diego Alvarez: no objections. :+1:
Tom Becker: good to go. :thumbsup:
Rina Sethi: i'll sign up for week 1 of remediation lead.
Kelsey Moore: thanks — will post signup link and pilot doc in #eng-oncall tomorrow.
